lines.text: Unlocks: Clear stage 6600105

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: Commander.

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: Today doesn't even seem real.

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: I got to go up to the surface

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: and defeat hordes of Raptures!

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: That's something we operators almost never get to do.

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: This is an experience that I'll treasure

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: for a long long time.
Me too.

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: Hehe.

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: I'm not sure if it was because it was something you and Deputy Chief Andersen prepared especially for me, but

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: it was such a thrill!

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: Even though it wasn't exactly realistic the way all those Raptures

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: blew up whenever I shot them.

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: That must have been the Counters' doing, right?

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: Tell them I said thanks.
... Sure. I'll do that.

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: All of this really gave me a new perspective.

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: Let me know if you ever need my help in the future.

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: I'll be more than happy to provide assistance!
Okay.

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: Hehe. You do realize I'm only kidding, right?

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: Anyway, I should get going. Got lots of work to do!

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: Thanks again for doing all this. Hehe!
